source.author: lucan
source.text: Propius iam fata moveri, Degeneres trepidant animi, peioraque versant, Ad dubios pauci, praesumto robore, casus Spemque metumque ferunt.
source.text_original: Propius iam fata moveri, / Degeneres trepidant animi, peioraque versant, / Ad dubios pauci, praesumto robore, casus / Spemque metumque ferunt.
source.text_english: Now the fates are being drawn nearer; degenerate minds tremble and turn to worse courses. A few, with confidence in their strength, bear both hope and fear toward uncertain fortunes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_original: pateant montes silvaeque lacusque / cunctaque claustra maris; spes et metus omnibus esto.
reuse.text_english: Let the mountains and forests and lakes and all the barriers of the sea be laid open; let hope and fear be for all.
